image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a white golf cart carrying three adults (two men and one woman) on a grassy course. The driver is in the foreground holding the steering wheel. The vehicle features a beige interior, a roof canopy, and a visible license plate on the front bumper.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the yellow license plate is illegible and structurally nonsensical, resembling AI-generated pseudo-text rather than real characters.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness and blending where the fingers meet the steering wheel rim, lacking crisp contact shadows typical of high-resolution photography.
The anatomy of the passenger on the far right shows ambiguous leg positioning and merging with the seat/background, suggesting minor structural incoherence.
